note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1949: nominations received by W. B. O'Donoghue, returning officer; four contests, polled 2 June 1949. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph ("Anti-Partitionist", "Unionist", "Independent"). Returned unopposed.
